properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT secret key for signing tokens. Must be at least 32 characters long for security.

properties.name: app.jwt.access-token-expiration
properties.description: Access token expiration time in milliseconds. Default is 900000 (15 minutes).

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-token-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token expiration time in milliseconds. Default is 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: List of allowed origins for CORS requests. Can be URLs or wildcard patterns.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: List of allowed HTTP methods for CORS requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: List of allowed headers for CORS requests (Authorization, Content-Type, etc.).

properties.name: app.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, authorization headers) in CORS requests.

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.max-failed-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of failed login attempts before account lockout. Default: 5

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.duration-minutes
properties.description: Account lockout duration in minutes. Default: 15 minutes

properties.name: app.audit.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Comma-separated list of trusted proxy IP addresses for extracting real client IP from X-Forwarded-For headers. Example: "172.17.0.1,10.0.0.1"

properties.name: app.audit.retention-days
properties.description: Audit log retention period in days. Audit logs older than this will be automatically deleted.
